fieldData.name: The RAF story begins
fieldData.label: Hangar 1
fieldData.story-line-1: We are in Hangar 1. This is where the RAF story starts.
fieldData.story-line-2: The RAF began in 1918. That is more than 100 years ago!
fieldData.grown-up-tip: Hangar 1 shows RAF Stories, the first 100 years. The Spitfire may be displayed high up, so look up together.

fieldData.name: The first war planes
fieldData.label: Hangar 2
fieldData.story-line-1: Brrr! The first planes were cold to fly.
fieldData.story-line-2: They were made of wood and cloth. Pilots sat in the open air, in the wind.
fieldData.story-line-3: Just like a penguin on the ice!
fieldData.grown-up-tip: Hangar 2 shows the First World War in the Air. Some aircraft hang from the ceiling.

fieldData.name: Faster and higher
fieldData.label: Hangars 3 and 4
fieldData.story-line-1: Whoosh! Planes got faster and faster.
fieldData.story-line-2: New pilots had to learn how to fly.
fieldData.story-line-3: And people invented helicopters and jets!
fieldData.grown-up-tip: Hangars 3 and 4 are one big space, separated by pillars. Look for the Harvard, the Hoverfly and the Phantom.

fieldData.name: The Second World War
fieldData.label: Hangar 5
fieldData.story-line-2: Here are big, heavy planes from the Second World War.
fieldData.story-line-3: Many of them flew at night, in the dark.
fieldData.grown-up-tip: Hangar 5 is the Bomber Hall. The Lancaster 'S for Sugar' is the star. The Komet is very small, so look carefully.

fieldData.name: Modern times
fieldData.label: Hangar 6
fieldData.story-line-1: Beep beep! Now we are in modern times.
fieldData.story-line-2: Some planes here can change shape.
fieldData.story-line-3: One has no pilot inside at all!
fieldData.grown-up-tip: Hangar 6 is The RAF in an Age of Uncertainty, 1980 to today. Some aircraft are displayed as if flying.
